metadata.name: elite-seller-leads-workspace
metadata.description: Screenshot-matched Seller Leads workspace with lead table, linked profile, county ZIP map, source donut, message panels and preserved saved-lead access.
features: Navy gold screenshot layout with complete navigation
Seven metrics, tabbed filterable sortable table and linked profile
Native project emblem and system icons
Preview lead/tag/status editing and draft-only SMS/email
Read-only saved records with native pagination dropzone

slots.name: paginationElement
slots.description: Native paginator for saved records; rendered in saved mode or editor.

specifications: Design preview is default and is explicitly labeled. Its sample rows and headline aggregates reproduce the screenshot; no sample is inserted into database.
Saved leads mode is read-only and consumes the existing bound table-view page. Search, sorting and counts apply to loaded records only.
Map uses geographic Census ZIP polygons plus optional Esri imagery; colors are categorical, not a heat score. Source attribution remains visible.
Calling sample contacts is disabled. Saved contact calls require a separate user click on Open phone app. No messaging is sent.
Dialogs trap focus, close on Escape and restore focus. Drafts, preview tags/statuses and offer worksheets remain in memory on this page.
All navigation destinations mirror existing project routes. Mobile sidebar toggles with Menu.
Original native workspace will be retained hidden for reversibility.
September 25 spacing pass: consistent topbar and panel spacing, focus/hover states; coded sidebars group secondary workspace links in More workspaces.
Desktop-priority layout: preserve multi-column workspace down to 760px of available content width; keep narrower responsive layouts. WeWeb editor device selection is independent of saved page styles.
